hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each catalog member is obtained by applying its operator to the latent univariate function F(z)=f(z). G0002 is F evaluated at z=x; G0003 is F evaluated at z=y; G0001 is the first divided difference of F with nodes x,y, giving (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y) = (f(x)-f(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: f is defined at x and y
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0002 and G0003 are point evaluations of the same univariate function f, and G0001 is the first Newton divided difference of that function on nodes x and y. This gives a single latent function with explicit evaluation and divided-difference operators.
